implementations should treat this as a separate filter.

QuotaKey.description:
A metered resource. Lifetime keys count current rows in their source-of-truth
table; temporal keys accumulate via `usage_events` + `quota_counters`.

String form (used in DB columns and JSON responses) is snake_case via `EnumString`.

QuotaPeriod.description:
Window kind for a quota. `Lifetime` is "ever / right now"; `Day`/`Week`/`Month`
reset on calendar boundaries (UTC); `PerSession` resets per opaque session id.

QuotaReport.description: Full quota report for an org; powers `/dashboard/billing`.

QuotaUsage.description: Single (key, period) entry in a usage report.

Role.description: A role name (e.g. admin, users:read) assigned to a user in an org.

q.description: Search text (ILIKE on name and email)

scope.description: `all`: search every user in the database (requires `users:list` on the root org). Otherwise org-scoped.

SingleResourceOutputOptions.description:
Options for single-resource operations (get/create/update/delete/restore).
Used when listing/filtering by `only_deleted` is not applicable.

include_deleted.description: If true, include soft-deleted items in results.

include_metadata.description: If true, include storage metadata (e.g. created_at, deleted_at) in results.

SingleResourceOutputOptionsQuery.description:
Query parameters for single-resource operations (get/create/update/delete/restore).
Omits `only_deleted` since it only applies to list endpoints.

schedules.description:
When set, replaces all schedule entries. Required when changing times/recurrence on an
invite that already has multiple schedule entries.

device_external_id.description: Device external_id. Must be a virtual_access_portal device in this integration. Use null to unlink.

expires_at.description: RFC3339 absolute expiration timestamp. Mutually exclusive with expires_in. Optional; if omitted, expiry is unchanged.

expires_in.description: Duration from now, e.g. "1d", "2w", "90d". Mutually exclusive with expires_at. Optional; if omitted, expiry is unchanged.

metadata.description:
Update (replace) persisted entity metadata.

- `None`: no change
- `Some(None)`: clear metadata
- `Some(Some(map))`: replace with provided map

name.description:
Update entity name.

- `None`: no change
- `Some(None)`: clear
- `Some(Some(name))`: set (trimmed; empty becomes clear)

config.description:
Tri-state patch semantics for `config`:
- field omitted: do not change config
- `"config": null`: clear config (set to None)
- `"config": { ... }`: replace config (do not merge)

oneOf.description:
Human-friendly name for this integration.
Accepts string or LocalizedString map, e.g. { "en": "Name", "he": "שם" }.

secrets.description:
Tri-state patch semantics for `secrets` (stored in Secrets Manager):
- field omitted: do not change secrets
- `"secrets": null`: clear secrets
- `"secrets": { ... }`: replace secrets

User.description: A provisioned user (identity) in the system.

email.description: Email address (used for login and provisioning).

Zone.description:
A logical or physical space (recursive for hierarchy).

Example: Floor 1 > Living Room > TV Nook

bearer_auth.description: OpenApp API key issued via `POST /api-keys`. Send as `Authorization: Bearer {base_url}_openapp_{secret}`. The SDK auto-derives the base URL from the token.
